description: This plot illustrates the relationship between a variable N and AUC (%). The x-axis is labeled "N" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "AUC (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 75 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The plot contains five solid lines, each distinguished by color and marker shape. The blue line with open circle markers begins at N=1 with an AUC of approximately 94%, rises to a peak of roughly 98.5% at N=5 and N=10, and then declines to end at approximately 94% at N=20. The orange line with open diamond markers starts at N=1 with an AUC of about 84%, steadily increases to a peak of approximately 95% at N=15, and slightly decreases to end at roughly 94.5% at N=20. The green line with open star markers begins at N=1 with an AUC of approximately 86.5%, rises steadily to peak at about 94.5% at N=15, and then declines to end at roughly 92.5% at N=20. The red line with open square markers starts at N=1 with an AUC of about 87%, rises to a peak of approximately 98.5% at N=10, and then declines to end at roughly 91.5% at N=20. Finally, the purple line with open downward-pointing triangle markers begins at N=1 with an AUC of approximately 79.5%, dips slightly to 79% at N=5, rises sharply to a peak of about 96.5% at N=10, and then declines to end at approximately 82.5% at N=20.
